title: Explainer script template
body:
Scene 1: wide establishing shot with a title card and soft music.

Scene 2: close-up on the key object while the narrator introduces the question the video answers.

Scene 3: animated diagram with captions, then a montage of supporting footage. Fade to the recap card at the end.

title: Storyboard pacing guide
body:
Narration at about 150 words per minute keeps an explainer clear. Hold each shot for at least four seconds so viewers can read captions.

Cut on action, use a slow zoom to add energy to still images, and keep the title scene under five seconds.
